Tests batch bytes extraction API (extract_batch)

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from xberg import extract_batch, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [ExtractInput(bytes=Path("pdf/fake_memo.pdf").read_bytes(), filename="fake_memo.pdf", kind=ExtractInputKind("bytes"))]
    result = await extract_batch(inputs)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
